Profit Margin Approval – User Guide

Odoo 17 · Sales · Cash sales order with profit margin control · written 2026-11-04

What this guide covers. How a cash sales order behaves when the items are sold below the company’s minimum profit margin: how to see the warning, request and give approval, and then finish the order through delivery, invoice and cash payment.
Steps
  1. Open the Sales app
  2. Create the quotation
  3. Recognise a low-profit order
  4. Check why the margin is too low
  5. Request margin approval
  6. Approve the margin
  7. Confirm the order
  8. Validate the delivery
  9. Create and post the invoice
  10. Register the cash payment
  11. Payment complete
  12. How the margin is calculated
  13. Tips and known issues

Before you start

  • You need access to the Sales app. Approving needs an authorised approver; the requester cannot approve their own request.
  • The minimum margin is a company setting (shown as Min. Sales Margin % in the details window – 22.9 % at the time of writing).
  • The margin check applies to Sales quotations; Project quotations are exempt.

Step by step

1

Open the Sales app

Log in to Odoo, open the Sales app and make sure the company in the top-right switcher is Jinasena Agricultural Machinery (Pvt) Ltd.. Then go to Orders → Quotations and click New.
2

Create the quotation

Fill in the quotation:
  • Customer – the customer buying the item.
  • Order Payment Type – Cash.
  • Quotation Type – Sales (Project quotations are exempt from the margin check).
  • Order Lines – add the product and quantity. Enter the Unit Price you intend to sell at.
  • Payment Terms (Other Info tab) – Immediate Payment; set the Sales Team and Warehouse.
Click Save. If the selling price leaves too little profit, the margin buttons in the next step appear automatically.
3

Recognise a low-profit order

When the profit margin is below the minimum, two things change at the top left of the order:
  • The Confirm button disappears – the order cannot be confirmed yet.
  • Request Insufficient Marginn Approval and Insufficient Margin Details appear. (The extra “n” in “Marginn” is how the button is spelt in Odoo.)
4

Check why the margin is too low

Click Insufficient Margin Details. Odoo shows a window titled Invalid Operation. This is not a failure – it is the explanation:
Item CodeThe product that is below the minimum
Base PriceSelling price per unit
Discounts / Other ChargesDiscount and commission that reduce the price
CostProduct cost used for the calculation
Net MarginResulting profit margin %
Min. Sales Margin %The minimum the company allows
Click Close. To avoid approval altogether, raise the unit price or lower the discount and save again.
5

Request margin approval

Click Request Insufficient Marginn Approval. The request is sent to the authorised approver. The button is replaced by Approve Insufficient Margin, which only the approver can use.
6

Approve the margin

The authorised person opens the quotation and clicks Approve Insufficient Margin. Once approved, the Confirm button comes back.
7

Confirm the order

Click Confirm. The quotation becomes a sales order (the stage changes to Sales Order) and a Delivery smart button appears.
8

Validate the delivery

Click the Delivery smart button, open the delivery and click Validate (use Check Availability first if stock is not reserved). The delivery status becomes Done.
9

Create and post the invoice

Return to the sales order and click Create Invoice, then Confirm the invoice. Its status becomes Posted.
10

Register the cash payment

On the invoice click Register Payment. Choose the cash journal (for example Customer Receipts – Cash); the amount is pre-filled with the full invoice total. Click Create Payment.
11

Payment complete

The invoice now shows the Paid / In Payment ribbon. The Sales Orders smart button on the invoice leads back to the original order, so the whole chain can be traced.

How the margin is calculated

net price = unit price − discount − commission
margin % = (net price − cost) ÷ net price × 100

Example from the screenshots: unit price 1,000, no discount, no commission, cost 1,200 → margin = (1,000 − 1,200) ÷ 1,000 × 100 = −20 %. The minimum is 22.9 %, so approval is required.

The cost comes from the product’s Cost field.

Tips and known issues

Button spelling. The button reads “Request Insufficient Marginn Approval” – this is how it is configured in Odoo.
Details open as an error window. “Insufficient Margin Details” displays its information in an Invalid Operation window by design. Read it and click Close.
  • No margin buttons appear. The margin is at or above the minimum, the product cost is 0, or the quotation type is Project. Check the product Cost.
  • Confirm is still hidden after approval. Reload the page; other approvals (credit, overdue, commission) may also be pending.
  • Invoice error “Account … is of payable type, but is used in a sale operation”. Seen for products carrying the VAT 18% (Sales) tax, whose tax account (22050010 VAT PAYABLE) is set up as a Payable account. This needs correcting by the system administrator.
  • The order opens on the Quotations list instead of the form. Open it again from Orders → Quotations.
Screenshots were captured from a live run on the testing database (order S00284). Related automated test: sales.margin-approval.spec.ts; technical notes: sales.margin-approval.notes.md.
